The U.S. HTS statistical suffixes under 3907.30 are:
- 3907.30.00 is the 8-digit level, "Epoxide resins".
- 3907.30.0010 is "Epoxide resins: Not in liquid or paste forms"... I am not certain this split exists.

My recollection of the schedule is:
- 3907.30.00.00 is historically the full 10-digit code for epoxide resins.
- More recently the schedule has been split into 3907.30.0010 (liquid epoxy resins, including bisphenol A) and 3907.30.0050 (other).

I can't confirm the current split, since no evidence was supplied. I will go with the base code 3907300000, which is the most commonly cited.
